# LibGuides at Kent School

> Kent School's library research guide providing access to academic databases, newspapers, archives, and peer tutoring support.

LibGuides at Kent School is the central hub for student and faculty access to the school's digital library resources, including subscription databases from major publishers like EBSCO, Gale, and JSTOR, as well as specialized collections and academic support services. The site serves Kent School's community with curated research tools and institutional knowledge.

## Key Topics

- Kent School
- Academic databases
- JSTOR
- EBSCO
- Gale
- Wall Street Journal
- Ancestry

- Kent School Archives

- Digital access
- Subject guides

## Database Directory

- [A-Z Databases](https://libguides.kent-school.edu/az.php): Comprehensive directory of academic databases including AAAS, ABC-CLIO, Ancestry, Digital Theatre+, EBSCO, Gale, JSTOR, and other research tools

## Newspapers & Magazines

- [Newspapers & Magazines](https://libguides.kent-school.edu/newspapers): Guide to newspaper and magazine subscriptions including New York Times, Wall Street Journal, The New Yorker, and other digital publications

## Academic Support

- [Peer Tutoring](https://libguides.kent-school.edu/peertutoring): Peer tutoring program information providing support in math, science, writing, and research skills

## Archives & Collections

- [Kent School Archives](https://libguides.kent-school.edu/archives): Access to Kent School's historical archives, collections, and archivist contact information for research inquiries
